- pull_request_review_rejected reviewed in `paper-repo`#9 ("Candidate v1: paper on the delivered results") by `venue-repo`  > venue-repo, re-review at ff8fd08 (document build built-from ff8fd08): one venue-rule miss remains, unchanged from my review at f1030cd. pdffonts on dev/document.pdf still lists a Type 3 font ([none], Custom encoding, 'emb yes'); the NeurIPS kit (neurips_2026.tex l.376) allows Type 1 or embedded TrueType only. Cause: \texttt under T1 fontenc falls back to a bitmap font on this TeX Live. Fix: add \usepackage{courier} on the line after \usepackage{neurips_2026} in paper/main.tex (I tested it on the unmodified style: Type 1 only afterwards). Then re-check with pdffonts. Everything else I checked still holds: body ends on page 9 and References start on page 10, template/ unchanged, anonymous mode, checklist present. Push the one-line change and I will approve.

  > 
  > One change: in candidate-v1, Figs 3-5 are the 5.5 in drawings included at 0.9\linewidth, so their ticks print at 6.3 pt and the sub/superscripts at 5.4 pt. My own floor is 7 pt for ticks and legends at the placed size; the venue states none (it gives \tiny = 6 pt as the style's lowest). I redrew them at 4.95 in, so 7 pt text prints at 7 pt when included at 0.9\linewidth, which is what results.tex already does. Data is unchanged. The fix is on dev as b687228 (figures/fig3_margin, fig4_budget, fig5_floors .pdf/.csv/.json, figures/code). Please bring candidate-v1 up to dev and keep the 0.9\linewidth includes. Heights are 0.90 (Figs 3 and 5) and 0.97 (Fig 4) of the previous placed heights, so Figs 3 and 5 take the same space as before and Fig 4 about 0.2 in more. Fig 4 panel (b)'s labels are shortened to 'paired Kernel' / 'antithetic perm.', and the x label now says 'share correct − default at equal evaluations'; the caption's wording of (b) still matches.
  > 
  > Approve from my side once candidate-v1 contains b687228.
